9-s139.answer: Две недели в Лондоне, дружелюбная семья, много достопримечательностей, новые друзья

10-s139.condition: Unit 4, Section 1, упр. 10, с. 139. Прочитай письмо Светы и скажи, верны ли утверждения.
steps: 1) False — Sveta wrote her letter in English. 2) False — Sveta is staying in London for two weeks. 3) True. 4) False — she has made some new friends. 5) True.

11-s139.condition: Unit 4, Section 1, упр. 11, с. 139. Выбери правильное время глагола.
steps: is playing; are watching; speaks; is sleeping; reads; is having.
11-s139.answer: is playing, are watching, speaks, is sleeping, reads, is having

12-s139.condition: Unit 4, Section 1, упр. 12, с. 139. Расскажи о визите в Лондон с группой одноклассников по обмену.
steps: I am staying in London for two weeks with my classmates. We are on an exchange programme. My exchange partner is John. He is 11 years old. He is friendly and likes football. His family is very kind. We go to school together and visit places of interest at the weekend.
12-s139.answer: Рассказ: программа обмена, партнёр, семья, чем занимаетесь

13-s139.condition: Unit 4, Section 1, упр. 13, с. 139. Напиши родителям письмо о пребывании в Лондоне.
steps: London, Great Britain, 6th May
Dear Mum and Dad,

I am writing to you in English because I am staying in London and I want to practise. I am staying with a nice host family. We have already been to the Tower, Big Ben and Hyde Park. The most interesting place is the Science Museum. I miss you!
Love, Sveta
13-s139.answer: Письмо родителям: адрес, дата, семья, что видел, что понравилось

14-s140.condition: Unit 4, Section 2, упр. 14, с. 140. Послушай, прочитай и разыграй историю о Гарри, Джимми и Оззи.
steps: Гарри, Джимми и Оззи хотели порадовать бабушку. Гарри сказал: «Я первый по естествознанию». Джимми: «А я первый по математике». Оззи: «А я первый выхожу из класса на перемену!»
14-s140.answer: Шутка о трёх братьях — разыграть по ролям

15-s140.condition: Unit 4, Section 2, упр. 15, с. 140. Прочитай и скажи, что ты узнал(а) о семье Мелинды.
steps: Melinda's family is close, they get on well. Her mother is a nurse and her father is an office manager. Melinda has got a sister and a brother. Her brother is a student. They like spending time together.
15-s140.answer: Дружная семья: мама — медсестра, папа — офис-менеджер, сестра и брат

16-s140.condition: Unit 4, Section 2, упр. 16, с. 140. Выбери правильные предлоги.
steps: on; of; at; of; for.

17-s140.condition: Unit 4, Section 2, упр. 17, с. 140. Послушай, повтори и прочитай слова.
steps: [e] — friendly, athletic, intelligent, independent.
[æ] — activity, athletic, tactful.
[ʌ] — butterfly, loving, understanding.
[əʊ] — opinion, polite, obedient.

17-s141.condition: Unit 4, Section 2, упр. 17, с. 141. Послушай запись, повтори и прочитай слова в рамке.
steps: friendly, athletic, intelligent, independent; activity, tactful; loving, understanding; polite, obedient; strong, optimistic, creative, responsible.

18-s141.condition: Unit 4, Section 2, упр. 18, с. 141. Прочитай текст и найди всех членов семьи на картинке.
steps: Dad, Mum, Charlie, Charlotte, Granddad, Grandma, Uncle, Aunt, the puppy.
18-s141.answer: Папа, мама, Чарли, Шарлотта, дедушка, бабушка, дядя, тётя, щенок

19-s142.condition: Unit 4, Section 2, упр. 19, с. 142. Посмотри на картинку и опиши каждого члена семьи.
steps: His dad is a tall and handsome man with clever eyes.
His mum is a slim and beautiful woman with fair hair.
His sister looks like his mum. She has fair hair and blue eyes.
His granddad is a kind old man with grey hair.
His grandma is a small woman with glasses.
19-s142.answer: Описание внешности: tall, slim, fair hair, blue eyes…

20-s142.condition: Unit 4, Section 2, упр. 20, с. 142. Ответь на вопросы о семье Чарли.
steps: 1) Charlie's mother's favourite colours are pink and light blue.
2) His sister is five. She is a small and pretty girl.
3) He wears jeans, pullovers and trainers.
4) His granddad likes fishing.
5) The puppy's name is Spot.
20-s142.answer: Ответы по тексту о семье Чарли

21-s142.condition: Unit 4, Section 2, упр. 21, с. 142. Напиши короткое описание друга или родственника.
steps: My sister's name is Katya. She has dark hair and green eyes. She is short and slim. She is a teacher at a school. She is a very energetic and kind person. She likes reading and travelling.
21-s142.answer: Описание 5–6 предложений: внешность, работа, характер, увлечения

22-s142.condition: Unit 4, Section 2, упр. 22, с. 142. Напиши историю о своей семье.
steps: Once my sister decided to bake a cake for our mother's birthday. She thought it was easy. When we came home, we saw a messy kitchen. My little sister was covered in flour. But the cake was delicious and Mum was happy.
22-s142.answer: Смешная история о семье в Past Simple

23-s142.condition: Unit 4, Section 2, упр. 23, с. 142. Послушай, повтори и выучи стихотворение «Твоя сестра».
steps: Стихотворение-совет: не толкай сестру, не дразни её, не обзывай — будь добрым.

24-s142.condition: Unit 4, Section 2, упр. 24, с. 142. Послушай и повтори слова. Соотнеси антонимы.
steps: kind — cruel; polite — impolite; friendly — unfriendly; obedient — naughty; clever — stupid; athletic — non-athletic; tactful — rude; quiet — noisy; happy — unhappy.
24-s142.answer: kind/cruel, polite/impolite, friendly/unfriendly, obedient/naughty, clever/stupid, tactful/rude

25-s143.condition: Unit 4, Section 2, упр. 25, с. 143. Прочитай анекдот и напиши, что могло произойти дальше.
steps: I think everyone laughed. The boy's father offered his seat to the woman and then explained the situation to his son.

26-s143.condition: Unit 4, Section 2, упр. 26, с. 143. Сделай семейный альбом: a) подпиши фотографии членов семьи; b) напиши о семейной традиции.
steps: a) This is my loving family. My little brother is very clever and funny. My mum is understanding and kind. My dad is strong and athletic. My granny is the best cook.
b) We celebrate birthdays together. On my last birthday my mum cooked a chocolate cake and we played board games. My grandparents came with presents. It's our family tradition.
26-s143.answer: Альбом: подписи к фото + рассказ о традиции

27-s143.condition: Unit 4, Section 2, упр. 27, с. 143. Послушай, повтори и выучи стихотворение «Мой старший брат».
steps: Стихотворение о ссоре с братом: поссорились из-за пустяка, но потом помирились.

28-s143.condition: Unit 4, Section 2, упр. 28, с. 143. Опиши маму, сестру, брата, папу или лучшего друга.
steps: I would like to tell you about my best friend. His name is Anton. He is twelve years old. He has short fair hair and green eyes. He is very tall. He is friendly, clever and athletic. He plays football and likes computer games. We get on very well.
28-s143.answer: Описание 6–7 предложений: возраст, внешность, характер, увлечения

29-s143.condition: Unit 4, Section 2, упр. 29, с. 143. Опиши одноклассника так, чтобы другие догадались, кто это.
steps: This person has a good sense of humour, that's why she gets on well with all her classmates. She is a beautiful girl with long straight fair hair and green eyes. She is good at Maths and likes dancing. Who is she?

30-s143.condition: Unit 4, Section 2, упр. 30, с. 143. Послушай и повтори слова, догадайся о значении выделенных прилагательных.
steps: athletic / non-athletic — спортивный / неспортивный; friendly / unfriendly — дружелюбный / недружелюбный; famous / infamous — известный / печально известный; polite / impolite — вежливый / невежливый; responsible / irresponsible — ответственный / безответственный.
30-s143.answer: Отрицательные приставки un-, non-, in-, im-, ir-

31-s144.condition: Unit 4, Section 2, упр. 31, с. 144. Скажи, что означают слова, и напиши противоположные.
steps: unfriendly — недружелюбный → friendly; unwell — нездоровый → well; untidy — неопрятный → tidy; unhappy → happy; impolite → polite; irresponsible → responsible; non-athletic → athletic.
31-s144.answer: friendly, well, tidy, happy, polite, responsible, athletic

32-s144.condition: Unit 4, Section 2, упр. 32, с. 144. Задай вопросы однокласснику, используя интервью из упр. 1 и 5.
steps: — Hello, may I ask you a few questions? — Yes, sure.
— Have you got a lot of friends? — Yes, I have. But I have only one best friend.
— What's her name? — Her name is Lena.
— What are your hobbies? — I like music and dancing.
— Do you get on well with your family? — Yes, we are a close family.
32-s144.answer: Интервью с одноклассником: друзья, хобби, семья

33-s144.condition: Unit 4, Section 2, упр. 33, с. 144. Скажи, какие люди тебе нравятся и почему.
steps: I like responsible people. They always do what they promise. I can rely on them. I also like people with a good sense of humour.

34-s144.condition: Unit 4, Section 2, упр. 34, с. 144. Спроси одноклассников, какие люди им нравятся.
steps: — What kind of people do you like? — I like responsible people.
— Why do you like responsible people? — They always do what they promise. I can rely on them.
— And what people don't you like? — I don't like rude people.
34-s144.answer: What kind of people do you like? — I like … because …

35-s144.condition: Unit 4, Section 2, упр. 35, с. 144. Скажи, с каким человеком ты хотел(а) бы дружить.
steps: I would like to be friends with a person who has a good sense of humour. It's great when your friends make you laugh. I also want my friend to be honest and kind.
35-s144.answer: I would like to be friends with a person who …

36-s144.condition: Unit 4, Section 2, упр. 36, с. 144. Прочитай шутку и разыграй её по ролям.
steps: — Granny, do you think Mum knows how to bring up children? — Why do you ask? — Because she makes me go to bed when I'm not sleepy and get up when I am!
36-s144.answer: Шутка о воспитании — разыграть по ролям
